moworks.notes: y −100 → 0 in 287 ms (fall, ease-in), up to −55 and down in 287 ms, up to −25 and down in 246 ms (parabolas), done at 820 ms; squash 30 / 18 / 8 % at the three contacts (scaleX = 1/scaleY, 100 ms triangles, origin bottom). After the last contact a check mark draws inside (260 ms) and a ring pings (+18 px, 480 ms). Params: drop (100 px) · bounces (55 / 25 px) · squash (0.3 / 0.18 / 0.08) · done: dấu tích (bật/tắt).
